name: devenv
description: Set up a machine and its toolchain once: migrate a legacy Python venv project to mise + uv, generate a stack-aware Makefile, manage dotfiles config files as symlinks, delegate SSH keys to hosts through an audited manifest, and register a Docker-container self-hosted GitHub Actions runner.

interface.shortDescription: One-time machine and toolchain environment setup
interface.longDescription: Devenv bundles the five skills used to set a machine up once and leave it reproducible: mise-migrate converts a legacy Python venv/pip project into the canonical mise + uv structure, makefile-gen detects a project's stack and generates a Makefile whose help/build/run/clear targets delegate to the existing mise tasks, package.json scripts or run scripts, symlink-manager moves a config file into the dotfiles repo and links it back with a backup, and ssh-delegate replaces ad-hoc ssh-copy-id with a manifest-backed, fingerprint-pinned, audit-logged delegation workflow, and runner-setup registers a Docker-container self-hosted GitHub Actions runner for a GHES or GitHub.com repo and moves its workflows onto it. All five write, and each stops for confirmation (or defaults to a dry run) before it does.
defaultPrompt: Migrate this venv project to mise + uv.
Generate a Makefile for this project.
Manage this config file with a symlink.
